prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: landscape social-preview raster for the VEEMAP Technologies homepage
Primary request: Create one cohesive premium editorial industrial composition presenting a conceptual, non-proprietary special-purpose assembly machine. Show the machine moving subtly from an exploded engineering point-cloud state into an assembled physical state, as a restrained left-to-right transition within one unified scene. The result should feel exact, engineered, sophisticated, and original—never like a real identifiable product or proprietary machine.
Scene/backdrop: pure solid black (#000000), with abundant controlled negative space and no environmental clutter.
Subject: one abstract special-purpose assembly machine made of generic precision modules, rails, frames, fixtures, and tooling; no identifiable brand, customer design, proprietary geometry, operating data, human figures, or readable component markings. The exploded side uses sparse off-white and signal-orange point-cloud particles and fine technical traces; the assembled side resolves into a clean sculptural machine form.
Style/medium: high-end 3D industrial visualization blended with editorial graphic design; sharp, refined, minimal, premium, cinematic but restrained; polished social-card finish.
Composition/framing: true landscape 16:9 social-preview layout, strong asymmetrical editorial balance, machine as the visual anchor, generous margins, clean hierarchy, no border.
Lighting/mood: low-key studio lighting, crisp rim light, precise highlights, deep blacks, subtle controlled atmosphere, no blue or multicolor lighting.
Color palette: use only pure black #000000, off-white #F2F2F2, and signal orange #FA4C14. Orange is a disciplined accent, not the dominant fill.
Materials/textures: matte black metal, finely machined dark surfaces, off-white luminous technical points, small signal-orange precision accents; no chrome overload.
Typography: modern bold condensed grotesk or neo-grotesk sans serif, uppercase, immaculate kerning, highly legible at thumbnail size. Render the headline exactly once as “SPECIAL PURPOSE. EXACT BY DESIGN.” in off-white, with selective signal-orange punctuation or emphasis only if clarity remains perfect. Render the supporting label exactly once as “VEEMAP TECHNOLOGIES” in smaller uppercase off-white or signal orange. Spell VEEMAP exactly V-E-E-M-A-P. Do not add any other text, letters, numerals, pseudo-text, badges, labels, captions, or watermarks.
Text (verbatim): "SPECIAL PURPOSE. EXACT BY DESIGN." and "VEEMAP TECHNOLOGIES"
Constraints: exact verbatim spelling and punctuation; one cohesive raster; readable typography; concept-only generic machine; no client logos; no certifications; no performance numbers; no proprietary details; no invented claims; no watermark.
Avoid: extra copy, gibberish text, UI chrome, blueprint grid overload, cyberpunk neon, glossy sci-fi tropes, busy factory backgrounds, people, robots with faces, client branding, certification marks, realistic manufacturer logos, trademarks, technical specifications, numerical callouts.
